== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Red 3]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed Limited and Unlimited cards, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Icons row: the printed cards have no [[Nav Computer]] icon (Limited faces Premiere-L-red3-hires.webp and Premiere-L-red3-decipher-archive.gif; Unlimited face Premiere-U-L-red3.jpg; Japanese face Japanese-Premiere-1301-145o-Video.jpg). The 2017 slip adds it, a red square with an astromech dome at the right of the game-text box, and the 2018 E card keeps it. The Scomp Link icon is at the left of the game-text box on every image.

Limited and Unlimited: the printed Limited card (600 dpi scan Premiere-L-red3-hires.webp) has no pilot sentence; [[Red 3 (Unlimited)]] (April 1996) adds it (Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, p. 35). The Decipher.com image Premiere-L-red3-decipher-archive.gif has a black border but the Unlimited text.
